title: Compactly supported IM 0-currents are finite integer sums of point evaluations
statement: Assume (MR) and (VO). (MR) is the exact frozen statement of cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: M_W(X) = R.measure(W) whenever R is an IMRep representing X ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U open, W open. (VO) is the exact frozen statement of dtc_vanish_off_support: S(ω) = 0 for every current S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) whose topological support is disjoint from spt S. Let P ∈ ℕ and let S ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity with compact support. Then there are a finite set F ⊆ spt S and integers m(x) (x ∈ ℝ^P) such that S(g) = Σ_{x∈F} m(x)·g(x)⟨⟩ for every test 0-form g on ℝ^P, where g(x)⟨⟩ denotes the value of the 0-covector g(x) on the empty tuple (fun i => i.elim0).
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 0), IsIntegerMultiplicity S → IsCompact S.support → ∃ (F : Finset (Euclid P)) (m : Euclid P → ℤ), (↑F : Set (Euclid P)) ⊆ S.support ∧ ∀ g : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 0, S g = ∑ x ∈ F, (m x : ℝ) * (g : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) x (fun i => i.elim0)
